spatial_claims.claim: Squares Q (side p) and R (side q) are constructed with areas equal to F and G respectively
Fourth proportional b is constructed such that p : q = a : b
Figure H is constructed similar and similarly situated to F, with b corresponding to side a
Q and R are similar figures (both squares) described on p and q; F and H are similar figures described on a and b
By 6.22, the proportion p : q = a : b yields Q : R = F : H

H is a figure similar to F constructed on side b via 6.18. No point positions, interior/exterior claims, ray orderings, or angle decompositions are involved. All objects exist independently as constructed figures and line segments used only in proportional reasoning.
